text:
Maria: heads up — after the kernel-autotune merge last night we're seeing a perf regression on short-context traffic (<64 tokens). p50 +18%, p95 +40% for prefill+decode path.
Jordan: can you paste the perf numbers and which commits?
Maria: commit 7f3a2e9 changed the heuristic that routes seqlen<=64 to the 'short-kernel' path; autotune now prefers fused-kv kernel for prefill.
Maria: perf summary:
```
baseline (old-heuristic): p50=45ms, p95=110ms
after autotune: p50=53ms, p95=154ms
error rate same, but CPU on host increases, more kernel handoffs visible
```
Jordan: hmm. do we have traces showing prefill->decode handoff counts?
Akash: pulled a flamegraph of a failing canary, looks like repeated KV cache loads during handoff. suspect we lost prefix caching on the fused-kv kernel. snippet from tracer:
```
# sampler output (short request)
prefill: fused_kv.forward  — 12ms
handoff: kernel_swap()        — 6ms (x3)
decode: small-decoder-kernel  — 22ms
KV loads: repeated 1->3 times per token on avg
```
runtime-bot: automated alert: route-change spike detected 2024-11-02T03:12Z — metric: route.handoff.count increased 3.4x for seqlen<64, p50 latency +18% (see /metrics/routing/2140001123) :rotating_light:
Sanjay: likely cause: fused-kv kernel implementation doesn't honor existing KV prefix pointer layout, so runtime triggers explicit swap+copy on handoff. regression path only for prefill->decode because decode expects non-fused layout.
Elaine: can we change the routing threshold back to 32 as a quick mitigation while we fix kernel glue?
Jordan: yes — propose a 1-hr canary reverting seqlen threshold and enabling legacy-kernel for prefill on short ctx. Command to run on canary pool:
```
rwctl apply-config --pool canary --set routing.short_threshold=32 --set routing.prefill_kernel=legacy-kv
```
Maria: did a dry-run locally, switching to legacy-kv reduces p50 back to ~46ms. I'll queue the canary patch now.
Akash: long-term fix: either make fused-kv honor prefix KV layout or add lightweight adapter that avoids full copy on handoff. I'll pick up the adapter patch. ETA EOD.
Sanjay: add unit test that simulates prefill->decode handoff and asserts no extra KV copies for seqlen<=64.
Elaine: notifying support + product about temporary canary; will add note to release channel.
Maria: plan: 1) roll canary (me) 2) Akash implements adapter (Akash) 3) Sanjay adds test + CI gate (Sanjay) 4) revert knob to autotune after validation. target EOD.
Jordan: thanks team. Maria / Akash — ping when canary is up, will watch metrics. :thumbsup:
